purpose.lod: Reuse the published B2 far exports at all existing distances. No new LOD switching or loading policy; inspect near/middle/far views honestly.
purpose.wind_bend_per_m: Inherited B2/B4 gentle attached sway, 18 mm lateral motion per metre of local height; exactly zero at rooted base.
purpose.wind_period_s: Inherited B2/B4 5.5 second slow wind cycle, driven by the existing pause-aware environment clock.
purpose.envelope_inset_fraction: Reserve 2.5 percent on each side of the old anchor envelope for sway, keeping the full deformed visual within the retained clearance envelope.
purpose.leaf_colour_gain: Inherited B4 warm olive multiplier for untextured ordinary foliage; textured shrub retains its source albedo and linear roughness/metal channels.
purpose.groups: Each part is [published role, fraction of existing horizontal envelope, fraction of existing height, local yaw radians]. All sources root at the SAME local origin, without new scatter/offsets. Existing habitat variants select two asymmetric silhouettes; native anchor yaw/scale is unchanged. Two crossed copies of the existing shrub source fill the original bush volume while sharing one retained root and staying inside its prior envelope.
purpose.leaf_normal_up_mix: Blend thin untextured foliage normals 72 percent toward world-up, retaining readable leaf faces in the existing dark habitat lighting without emissive fill or changing the world lights.
purpose.leaf_backlight: Reuse B4 canopy-style 0.22 diffuse backlighting for thin untextured leaves; no emission or magic on ordinary plants.
